name: @gemma/assets
description: Shared static brand assets consumed by both apps (Gemma mark and mark+wordmark lockup, UBC, MSL). Each .png ships beside its editable .xcf GIMP source so the source art can never drift from — or be misplaced apart from — the exported image; the four MSL cuts are the exception, supplied as exports with no source art, and the Gemma SVGs need none because vector art is its own source. Only the files re-exported from ./src/index.ts are bundled; the .xcf sources are co-located but never imported, and ./scripts/emit-favicon.mjs reads gemma-mark.svg from disk to generate each app's public/favicon.svg. Add an asset here only when both apps/browser and apps/curation would otherwise copy it.
